name: Falafel Seitan Bratwurst
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Spiced falafel mix (the chickpea variant, not the fava bean variant)

steps: Mix gluten flour and falafel mix in a ratio of 30:70 by volume.
Take 25% more water by volume than falafel-gluten mixture. Mix water with vegetable oil and soy sauce.
Form a dough from the dry mixture and the liquid mixture.
Roll the dough into sausages and fry them in an oiled non-stick pan.

culture.text: Bratwurst is a type of German sausage made from pork or, less commonly, beef, veal, or any combination of beef, veal, and pork. The name is derived from the Old High German Brätwurst, from brät-, finely chopped meat, and Wurst, sausage, although in modern German it is often associated with the verb braten, to pan fry or roast.
